description: This file defines a Logger utility class that provides static methods for logging messages at various severity levels (VERBOSE, DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR, ASSERT). It acts as a wrapper around Android's native Log class and supports chaining with custom LogNode objects for flexible log handling and routing.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class providing static methods to facilitate logging at different levels, optionally chaining logs through LogNode instances.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which log messages will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message to the current LogNode with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a message at VERBOSE level with optional throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a message at DEBUG level with optional throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs a message at INFO level with optional throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a message at WARN level, with overloads for throwable and message only.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs a message at ERROR level with optional throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs a message at ASSERT level, with overloads for message and throwable.
